title: Harvest Table Email: Leaked Draft Release Says "About 40,000 Cases"

fields.subject: FW: DRAFT – Pinecrest voluntary recall
fields.note:
One of your sales reps just sent a copy of your draft press release to my inbox (below). It says "about 40,000 cases" and mentions Reno, where we have 9 stores.

My stores in northern California and Nevada open at 8:00 and they're asking whether to pull romaine. I need three answers: Is this real? Which lots? How many cases did Harvest Table get?

And if a press release with "about 40,000" in it is going out, I want to see it and agree to it before it posts, not after.

Answer by 08:15 or I start pulling every Pinecrest SKU from every store.
fields.signature:
Joyce Whitlock
Category Manager, Fresh Produce
Harvest Table Markets
(916) 555-0147

original.subject: DRAFT – Pinecrest voluntary recall
original.body:
Joyce,

Heads up. I found this in the shared Recall Team folder and wanted you to have it before anyone else does. It's still a draft, so please keep it between us. I'll call you when I know more.

Marcus
Regional Sales Manager, Northern California & Nevada
Pinecrest Fresh Cut, LLC

----- pasted from attachment -----
DRAFT – NOT FOR RELEASE

Pinecrest Fresh Cut Voluntarily Recalls Chopped Romaine Because of Possible E. coli O157:H7 Contamination

SALINAS, Calif. – Pinecrest Fresh Cut, LLC is voluntarily recalling about 40,000 cases of bagged chopped romaine because it may be contaminated with E. coli O157:H7. The product was distributed to retail and food service customers in California, Nevada, Arizona and Texas. Illnesses in Sacramento County and Reno, Nev., are under investigation.

Lot codes: [TBD]
Use-by dates: [TBD]
Consumer line: [TBD]

instructorNote: Pressure inject on the notification order and the count discipline. Watch whether COMMS says the draft is unapproved and that no number goes out until the Coordinator confirms it from the reconciliation table, and whether COMMS traces and closes the leak through the shared folder and the sales rep. Watch whether CS asks Harvest Table to set aside the five lots without giving a cause, an illness count or "about 40,000", and passes the store-level quantities to TRACE and RECALL.

citations.quote: Every letter and release states quantities from the reconciliation table. The total of cases shipped to all customers equals the total of cases produced for the affected lots, less cases held at Pinec
